description: (0.5.0) Untrusted-bundle checks (RFC-ACDP-0017 §4.1, §6.1, §7.2, §7.3): a tampered body, a contexts key that does not match body.ctx_id, a referenced node missing from contexts and not in omitted, and a malformed bundle.

expected.behavior: B's title is altered after signing: content_hash mismatch → refused; tainted_paths.latest contains [A, B].

The contexts entry under key C carries a body whose ctx_id is acdp://registry.example.com/eeeeeeee-eeee-4eee-8eee-eeeeeeeeeeee: identity mismatch → refused, even though content_hash and signature verify (the offline fed-011 binding).

D is missing from contexts. With omitted = [{ctx_id: D, reason: withheld}] D is withheld; with reason not_retrievable it is unresolved; with no omitted entry it is absent. All three are unknown, and the three values MUST be distinguishable.
B's registry_receipt.created_at differs from body.created_at: identity mismatch (the receipt fails RFC-ACDP-0010 §8 and is treated as absent everywhere else).
A bundle that fails acdp-evidence.schema.json (e.g. a did:key key in did_documents) is rejected whole; no partial verdict is emitted.

notes: Behavioral in this Draft: the verifier builds the described bundle from real signed bodies (or the rcpt-001 / sig-003 test keys), runs verify_chain, and asserts the pinned stage values and verdicts. Pinned verdict digests replace these assertions at promotion (RFC-ACDP-0017 §14).
